findings.location: Assumptions and constraints, final bullet; Completion criteria 2; Increment A step 1
findings.problem: The planned tracked inventory identifies untracked global files by name/path and content hash only. Project policy requires any tracked citation of untracked content to include a source URL, retrieval date, and content hash, and forbids tracked material from pointing at untracked paths. The proposed record therefore cannot meet the repository’s provenance rule as written.
findings.suggestion: Define a compliant provenance form for this owner-local source before implementation, or revise the work so the tracked spec records only a non-path-based, policy-compliant source identifier with retrieval date and hash.

findings.problem: It still says the record is empty even though round 1 was requested, completed, and its findings were dispositioned. This omits the required record of the review outcome.
findings.suggestion: Record round 1, its findings and their applied dispositions; add this round’s outcome when it closes.

summary: The plan needs a compliant way to record provenance for the untracked global configuration. The earlier review outcome also needs to be recorded.
